info.summary: Open, edit and browse .excalidraw files with a built-in navigator and public sharing
info.description: Open and edit .excalidraw files with the Excalidraw editor. Changes are automatically saved back to your Nextcloud files. Includes a navigator page with folder tree and public link viewer with PNG/SVG export.
info.author: KaustubhPatange (original), Etagi (fork)
